args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66) but
round_money was quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP. Fix to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to
match the documented behavior and nightly build expectations.

args.body:
### Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212) but `src/money.py` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

### Fix
- `round_money` now uses `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, consistent with its docstring and the FIN-212 requirement (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`, `2.675 -> 2.68`).

### Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/money-bankers-rounding-fin212` (commit `08d3cd5986`) passed.
